questions.qtext: In a Hartnell governor, if a spring of lower stiffness is used, then the governor will be
questions.solution:
(b)
If the stiffness is lowered, then the resisting force of spring will decrease and the balls will be
moving more away from the spindle axis i.e. the movement of the sleeve for a fractional change
of speed get increase, thus increasing its sensitiveness.
